name: Ministerio de Salud
body: HSTS marked for preload, a CSP from default-src 'self', a Permissions-Policy, and no-referrer. But several links on the home page return 404, among them the giro directo page, the national contact point, and emergencies.
lesson: Run a link check on your home page every week. It's the page most people start from.
summary: www.minsalud.gov.co scores 60 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 28 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 6 internal links lead to an error.

fix.title: 6 internal links lead to an error
fix.evidence: /proteccionsocial/paginas/giro-directo-del-gobierno-nacional-a-las-instituciones-prestadoras-de-servicios-de-salud.aspx answered 404, linked from /, /Paginas/InicioV2.aspx. /salud/publica/CNE/Paginas/centro-nacional-enlace-home.aspx answered 404, linked from…
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: 1 page has no title
fix.fix: Give every page a unique title of about 30 to 60 characters.

fix.title: 12 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /sites/rid/paginas/freesearchresults.aspx?k=*&ss=Todos, /Avisos%20y%20Licitaciones/Forms/AllItems.aspx. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 6 pages have no measurement tag while the start page does
fix.evidence: /piloto/centro-de-comunicaciones.html, /piloto/informacion-de-la-entidad.html, /Ministerio/DSector/Paginas/estudios-sectoriales.aspx, /Ministerio/RCuentas/Paginas/contratacion.aspx and 2 more. Visits to those pages are invisible in the reports.
fix.fix: Load the same tag from the shared layout on every page.

fix.title: 14 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without HttpOnly: SearchSession. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /sites/rid/paginas/freesearchresults.aspx?k=*&ss=Todos.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 404 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
The start page reads well without JavaScript
